feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 24 October 2026 10:51pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Saturday, 24 October 2026 at 10:50pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Gale force westerly winds will increase to severe gale force in many places overnight; gusts of 60-70mph, but with storm force gusts of 70-75mph in more exposed locations, with some further damage in places. Clear spells and isolated showers will accompany these very strong winds. Minimum temperature 6°C.

Sunday will see sunshine and isolated showers. The westerly gale or severe gale force winds will only decrease very slowly through the day, only dropping below gale force late afternoon and evening, with further travel disruption in the morning and to about mid-afternoon. Top temperature 12°C.


##Outlook##

A band of rain will arrive on Monday morning, clearing through the afternoon to leave a dry spell before further rain arrives at night. Following a relatively quiet start, another spell of strong to gale force winds will develop later in the day and continue into Tuesday.
